facts.value: Discover the diverse offerings for international students and researchers at Goethe University and shape your personal academic path.

Opportunities for a stay abroad include semester abroad, ERASMUS study, internships, or engagement in research and teaching – an experience abroad opens many new opportunities and perspectives for your personal and professional development.
Goethe University is characterized by its internationalism: as an international university, it is globally connected and maintains numerous international university partnerships.
Internationality shapes our research, our study programs, and our campus. In this sense, everyone associated with Goethe University is international – regardless of their background.
